summary: All 36 source files matched their recorded hashes and sizes, and all nine proposed computations reproduced. Of 29 Figure 7 coefficients, 28 paired with registered genes and all 28 agreed in direction (Pearson 0.9954, Spearman 0.9854). The selected-effects comparison stands, two pairs short of the concordance minimum. The corrected proposal fixes the paper-access status and day-39 sample links, documents a nonnumeric cell in the normalized workbook, and clarifies figure selection and nominal significance.
openIssues: The reviewed sources lack the full author DE table, exact gene-level P values, and adjusted P values. The publisher inventories omit the cited Table S9 workbook.
The authors’ exact RIN adjustment, the rule behind the reported 80 DEGs, and the conflicting tissue headings in the day-39 biomarker workbook remain unresolved.
